args.body: Hi Eve! I visited your blog. It's nice and personal, and I like that your love of hiking comes through. It would be even better with more detail, such as trail stories, photos, and tips, plus some navigation and a clearer layout. Keep it up!

Hi Dora! I visited your personal website. It's clean and the contact info is easy to find. You could make it stronger by adding more about yourself, such as your projects, interests, or portfolio, and by adding some visuals and a clearer structure. Nice work!

final_text:
